name: Excalidraw
summary: Whiteboards that stay: Excalidraw with tabs, a trash and a library per item.
description:
Excalidraw with server-side persistence. Each item is a set of boards in tabs; drawings, pasted images and your shape library are saved as you work, and deleted boards sit in a trash until you empty it.

The client of excalidraw-persist by ozencb (MIT), running on your own Hamstr. Share links and collaboration are not included: an item belongs to the person who made it.
